name: Extreme Summarization (XSum)
description: A news summarization dataset containing BBC articles paired with concise, one-sentence summaries, designed to test abstractive summarization systems.
citation: Narayan, S., Cohen, S. B., & Lapata, M. (2018). Don't Give Me the Details, Just the Summary! Topic-Aware Convolutional Neural Networks for Extreme Summarization. Proceedings of the 2018 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing, 1797–1807. https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/D18-1206

license.notes: The upstream repository does not identify a standard SPDX license for the dataset. The data contains BBC articles; review upstream terms and rights in the underlying source content before use or redistribution.
